name: workbuddy
label: WorkBuddy
query: SELECT id, cwd, COALESCE(NULLIF(custom_title,''), title, '') AS title, status, COALESCE(is_background_automation, 0) AS bg, CASE WHEN COALESCE(is_background_automation, 0) = 1 AND status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bg_recovered FROM sessions WHERE last_activity_at > ? AND deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT (COALESCE(is_background_automation, 0) = 1 AND status NOT IN ('error','completed')) ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC LIMIT 60

rules._note: 后台自动化平时不上报，但它失败过之后必须能把「已恢复」传回来，否则面板永远停在旧的 failed 快照上。auto 让这条只纠正状态、不产生未读。
